mapper.select: SELECT SalesNo AS salesNo, SalesSeq AS salesSeq, ProductCode AS productCode, ProcessCode AS processCode, Price AS price, Qty AS qty, Discount AS discount, Cost AS cost, OrderNo AS orderNo, OrderSeq AS orderSeq, DeliveryNo AS deliveryNo, DeliverySeq AS deliverySeq, Remark AS remark FROM SalesDetail WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo} ORDER BY SalesSeq

SELECT DISTINCT sm.SalesNo AS salesNo, sm.CustCode AS custCode, sm.Qty AS qty, sm.Discount AS discount, sm.Cost AS cost, sm.BankingYn AS bankingYn, sm.Status AS status, dm.DeliveryDate AS deliveryDate FROM SalesMaster sm INNER JOIN SalesDetail sd ON sd.SalesNo = sm.SalesNo INNER JOIN DeliveryMaster dm ON dm.DeliveryNo = sd.DeliveryNo
sm.SalesYn = 'N'
AND sm.CustCode = #{custCode}
ORDER BY dm.DeliveryDate DESC, sm.SalesNo DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SalesMaster SET SalesDate = GETDATE(), SalesYn = 'Y', BankingYn = #{bankingYn}, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId} WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo}

IF EXISTS ( SELECT SalesNo FROM SalesMaster WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo} ) UPDATE SalesMaster SET SalesDate = #{salesDate}, CustCode = #{custCode}, Qty = #{qty}, Discount = #{discount}, Cost = #{cost}, BankingYn = #{bankingYn}, Status = #{status}, SalesYn = #{salesYn}, UpdateDate = GETDATE(), UpdateUserID = #{updateUserId} WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo} ELSE INSERT INTO SalesMaster ( SalesNo, SalesDate, CustCode, Qty, Discount, Cost, BankingYn, Status, SalesYn, InsertDate, InsertUserID ) VALUES ( #{salesNo}, #{salesDate}, #{custCode}, #{qty}, #{discount}, #{cost}, #{bankingYn}, #{status}, #{salesYn}, GETDATE(), #{insertUserId} )

IF EXISTS ( SELECT SalesNo, SalesSeq FROM SalesDetail WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo} AND SalesSeq = #{salesSeq} ) UPDATE SalesDetail SET ProductCode = #{productCode}, ProcessCode = #{processCode}, Price = #{price}, Qty = #{qty}, Discount = #{discount}, Cost = #{cost}, OrderNo = #{orderNo}, OrderSeq = #{orderSeq}, DeliveryNo = #{deliveryNo}, DeliverySeq = #{deliverySeq}, Remark = #{remark} WHERE SalesNo = #{salesNo} AND SalesSeq = #{salesSeq} ELSE INSERT INTO SalesDetail ( SalesNo, SalesSeq, ProductCode, ProcessCode, Price, Qty, Discount, Cost, OrderNo, OrderSeq, DeliveryNo, DeliverySeq, Remark ) VALUES ( #{salesNo}, #{salesSeq}, #{productCode}, #{processCode}, #{price}, #{qty}, #{discount}, #{cost}, #{orderNo}, #{orderSeq}, #{deliveryNo}, #{deliverySeq}, #{remark} )
